subject: Fall cohort close-out
snippet: Ryan,  Close-out for the fall cohort, so it's all in one place:  - A participant completes
body:
Ryan,

Close-out for the fall cohort, so it's all in one place:

- A participant completes pre-service training with all ten sessions attended in full, 6:00 to 9:00 PM. Anyone who arrives after 6:15, leaves before 9:00 or misses a session has to make it up with your co-facilitator before we can certify them.
- Email me the names of everyone who graduates on the 10th by noon the next day, so we can open their home-study files.
- I'll send the completion attestation through DocuSign. It also certifies your facilitator payment of $10,000 for the fall cohort, so it needs your own signature.
- Certificates from your printer as usual; we reimburse the print bill.

Thanks for another good cohort.

Carla Simmons
Coordinator, Resource Parent Training Unit
Baltimore City DSS
